CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.provider_publish_by_default()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.lifecycle_status = 'active' then new.publication_status := 'published'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

args: p_filters jsonb, p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_sort text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.site_host_v1(p_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select nullif(lower(regexp_replace(substring(btrim(coalesce(p_url, '')) from '^(?:https?://)?([^/:?#\s]+)'), '^www\.', '')), '')
$function$
